comment: The inbound fragmentation helper is responsible for assembling fragmented EAP-TTLS data.

variables.name: FRAGMENTATION_STATUS_ACK
variables.comment: ACK indicates that an inbound fragment has been processed and an ACK should be sent

variables.name: FRAGMENTATION_STATUS_ASSEMBLED
variables.comment: ASSEMBLED indicates that fragments have been reasembeled and data can now be processed

variables.name: FRAGMENTATION_STATUS_INVALID
variables.comment: INVALID indicates some kind of failure likely due to an unexpected request or invalid data

methods.name: public int assembleInboundMessage(EapTtlsTypeData typeData)
methods.comment:
* This method is responsible for processing incoming fragmented data (RFC5281#9.2.2)
     *
     * @param typeData the type data to process
     * @return a fragmentation status indicating the result of the process

methods.name: public byte[] getAssembledInboundFragment()
methods.comment:
* Retrieves assembled inbound fragmented data
     *
     * @return a byte array containing an assembled inbound fragment

methods.name: public boolean isAwaitingFragments()
methods.comment:
* Indicates whether a fragmentation session is currently in progress
     *
     * @return true if fragmentation is in progress
